description: Liste des Autorités Organisatrices de la Mobilité (AOM) is a dataset listed in transport.data.gouv.fr, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Cerema. Open transport information data for France. Coverage: France. The portal lists 20 resources (csv, ods, xlsx, html, xls) and files the dataset under the type "informations". The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-france-transport-data-gouv-national-access-point.
name: Liste des Autorités Organisatrices de la Mobilité (AOM)
notes: Harvested from the transport.data.gouv.fr API (/api/datasets) on 2026-09-29 as part of the second portal harvest; the portal listing has no free-text description, so the description states only what the listing gives.
